name: Sustained Infrastructure Holding Company
summary: Sustained Infrastructure Holding Company, an investment holding company, engages in ports and logistics, and water solutions businesses in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. It operates through Port development operations; Water desalination and distribution; and Logistics parks and support services segments. The company develops and manages port terminal operations, maritime services, warehouse services, supply chain solutions, associated development, water desalination, treatment plant and sale of water; logistics park and support services; development and operation of industrial zones, construction and operation of restaurants, catering and entertainment centres, gas station…
